title: Over 50 TBS members nabbed in September 2025 Mendiola protest, says DILG
summary: More than 50 members of the alleged gang True Brown Style (TBS) were among the 200 individuals arrested during the September 21, 2025 protest in Manila, according to Interior Secretary Jonvic Remulla.
